extracted.name: Restaurant-Style Slaw
extracted.description: This restaurant-style coleslaw recipe tosses finely chopped cabbage and carrots with a creamy, tangy buttermilk dressing for a classic side dish.
instruction_lines: Whisk sugar, salt, ground black pepper, milk, mayonnaise, buttermilk, vinegar, and lemon juice together in a large bowl until smooth. Add cabbage and carrots; toss until evenly coated with dressing. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
